name: lease-enforcement-cache
title: Lease enforcement cache
description: Implement a fixed-capacity allocation-free resource lease reducer and motion enforcement cache with session restart safety and two-phase preemption.
scope: application-module resource lease reducer and motion enforcement cache
creator: mj
notes: Software-only G3 child complete. control-core now owns a fixed-capacity allocation-free lease reducer and motion enforcement cache with strict epochs, exact grant/renew/release/expiry authorization, two-phase preemption, typed removal evidence and fail-closed session loss/restart. Eight host tests cover invalid transitions, interleaved competing owners, exclusive expiry and zero allocations. Targeted checks, architecture policy and final tools/ci.sh passed. FSM priority policy, motion process wiring, physical safe action, Orange Pi and target timing qualification remain out of scope.
